neighbours.label: The coordinator joining a second item inside the scope of a negation ('without X or Y', 'no X or Y'): the 'or' of negated alternatives
fire: The cabin has no running water or electricity.
He left the house without a coat or an umbrella.
This soup contains no cream or butter at all.
They walked for miles without food or rest.
The phone works without a SIM card or a contract.
There is no parking or bike storage at the venue.
She answered the question without hesitation or doubt.
The fabric needs no ironing or dry cleaning.
quiet: The cabin offers either a wood stove or electric heating.
He left the house with a coat and an umbrella.
This soup can be finished with cream or butter.
They walked for miles with food and rest along the way.
The phone comes with a SIM card or an eSIM, as you prefer.
There is parking and bike storage at the venue.
She answered the question with hesitation and some doubt.
You can pay by card or in cash at the venue.

predictions: 'without X or Y' and 'no X or Y' items reach 0.2-0.45 on ' or' or the word after it; positive versions of the same sentences ('with X and Y', 'either X or Y') stay under 0.05. Risk: 'does not require X or Y' scored only 0.120 in the probe, so some fire items may fall short of 0.3.
notes: Probe: 'without milk or sugar' 0.416 (peak ' or'), 'need no electricity or batteries to glow' 0.400 (peak ' to'), 'without having written a will or named' 0.166, 'does not require injections or surgery' 0.120, 'neither realistic nor practical' 0.050; positive controls 0.006-0.021. Card: ' or' x7, ' and' x6 all inside negations (don't need X or Y, without milk or cream, not realistic or practical, free from X and Y). The test keeps 'without'/'no' forms, which scored highest.
